messages.text: Summarise the Q3 retention report and identify the strongest changes.
I reviewed the quarterly report, the plan mix and the onboarding notes.
Churn fell to 2.1% in Q3, led by annual plans and faster onboarding.
Annual plans kept the strongest retention. A shorter onboarding path helped new teams reach their first useful result sooner.
Next, compare the first thirty days for monthly and annual cohorts, and keep tracking the time to first value.
